source_spec: CUE_NOTES_FIXPASS.md (box audio_restart/); supersedes AUDIO_RESTART_V01.md and CUE_NOTES_FORGE_V2.md where they differ; battle cues: CUE_NOTES_BATTLE_V1.md
mirrors: data/audio_cues.json: same cue ids, files (path) and buses. 53 cues: 38 from the fix pass/adventure + 15 sfx_battle_* (in audio_cues.json, wired by battle playback job 21; rules in audio_cues.json battle_playback). This file is documentation; code reads audio_cues.json only.
format: ogg (SFX/stings: Vorbis 44.1 kHz mono); hub bed mp3 48 kHz stereo

bus_rules.Music: Hub bed + stings. Default -9 dB (MUSIC_BUS_DEFAULT_DB). Forge: 1500 Hz low-pass + reverb 0.35 + -3 dB.
bus_rules.SFX_World: Anything that repeats (gather, wisps, water, Forge jobs, door). Never ducks.
bus_rules.SFX_Progress: Rare milestones only; ducks the bed. Final set: sfx_stage_up, sfx_fruit_ready, sfx_fruit_harvest, sfx_ascend, sfx_upgrade_buy, sfx_forge_big_done, sfx_path_open. No bus changes in the fix pass.
bus_rules.Battle: sfx_battle_* cues are on SFX_World (combat) or SFX_UI (turn/select/confirm/flee/victory/overwhelmed), never on SFX_Progress; none duck the bed. Battle playback is the only caller; idle/offline/Simulate resolves are silent.

duck.notes: Gain envelope on the hub bed (MusicPlayer.volume_db), not a compressor. Overlapping Progress cues extend the hold, never stack below -5 dB. Stings are not ducked. audio_cues.json duck block must change to attack_sec 0.05 / release_sec 0.6 (was 0.15 / 1.2).

volume_model: Every play sets volume_db = base_db + play_offset_db and pitch_scale explicitly (1.0 unless noted); nothing carries over from the previous play. base_db is 0.0 for all cues this pass. Voices: SFX pool of 4 (SFX_UI + SFX_World), Progress pool of 2; MusicPlayer and StingPlayer unchanged.
rulings: Post-Ancient freeze / Fruit-commit hold (GameState.fruit_committed): only the music bed plays. No gather ticks, no SFX_World, no Forge job cues (craft_start, craft_done, press_squeeze, big_done). SFX_UI (Ascend button, shop) and the freeze's own fruit_harvest/ascend cues + stings are fine.
Milestone cues (stage_up, fruit_ready, ...) play on live transitions only, never on save load or scene restore.
Hub/Forge switch buttons reuse sfx_door_bark (no new asset).
Autosave and offline results are silent.
New sound assets need Haex's explicit go (not only the Director's).

mus_hub_forest.notes: Hub bed. Haex's raw MP3 (48 kHz stereo, 178.3 s, peak 0 dBFS), loop on; the fade-out loop join is ACCEPTED (Haex lock), do not crossfade or fix. Fallback chain: JSON path, then this shipped MP3 only. Music bus default -9 dB. Ducked -5 dB (bed only) while any SFX_Progress voice plays. Plays through the post-Ancient freeze.

mus_fruit_sting.notes: With sfx_fruit_harvest (Fruit commit or Ancient timeout). StingPlayer over the bed; not ducked.

mus_ascend_sting.notes: With sfx_ascend on Ascend confirm. StingPlayer over the bed; not ducked.

mus_title.notes: Unused (title plays the hub bed). Kept: cue references it.

sfx_ui_deny.notes: Alias: reuses sfx_ui_cancel.ogg. Echo portal fee denied.

sfx_gather_wood.notes: Keeper gains wood (keeper_harvested); pitch 0.96-1.04; global 0.9 s gap, skip not queue; Keeper only, hub only, not frozen

sfx_gather_stone.notes: Keeper gains stone (keeper_harvested); same rules as sfx_gather_wood

sfx_gather_food.notes: Keeper gains food (keeper_harvested); same rules as sfx_gather_wood; softest file (-17.8 dBFS), watch in playtest

sfx_gather_manashards.notes: Unmapped: Keeper harvest is wood/stone/food only; shards come from the water channel (sfx_water_pulse). Would be -12 dB if ever used.

sfx_tree_deny.notes: Can't afford / blocked: Grow pay, Runestones, Bench craft.

sfx_stage_up.notes: Live stage_changed only (not sapling); never on save load or scene restore. At Ancient plays first; sfx_fruit_ready follows 0.7 s later on a separate voice.

sfx_fruit_ready.notes: Live fruit_ready_changed(true), once per cycle; never on load. At Ancient: 0.7 s after sfx_stage_up, separate Progress voice.

sfx_fruit_harvest.notes: With mus_fruit_sting (Fruit commit or Ancient timeout).

sfx_upgrade_buy.notes: Shop buy, Runestone rank, relic swap (one per player click).

sfx_wisp_deny.notes: Forge station full / queue on busy station.

sfx_forge_craft_start.notes: Manual queue/start by the player only (try_begin_job). NEVER on auto-repeat cycles.

sfx_forge_craft_done.notes: Upcycle (crucible/mill/press) cycle done, in the Forge scene only; silent elsewhere (upcycle_tick_db)

sfx_press_squeeze.notes: Manual Bramble Press (press) queue only, with craft_start; never per cycle.

sfx_forge_big_done.notes: Anvil and Reliquary completion only, any scene, throttle 3 s (big_done_min_interval_sec). Dropped during the freeze.

sfx_door_bark.notes: Forge enter/exit, and the Hub/Forge switch buttons (via try_enter_forge/exit_forge; no extra cue).

sfx_path_open.notes: Thorn path opens after Bramble is spared or defeated. Live transition only; not on save load. Haex may tweak the sound later.

sfx_battle_hit.notes: Haex go 2026-10-10 via the Director. Battle v1 (Strike result Hit (core impact)). Normal Hit at -3 dB. Fixed pitch, ±4% jitter/±1 dB; no pitch_scale for speed. See CUE_NOTES_BATTLE_V1.md.

sfx_battle_graze.notes: Haex go 2026-10-10 via the Director. Battle v1 (Strike result Graze). Graze at -6 dB; filtered sibling of hit. Fixed pitch, ±4% jitter/±1 dB; no pitch_scale for speed. See CUE_NOTES_BATTLE_V1.md.

sfx_battle_crush.notes: Haex go 2026-10-10 via the Director. Battle v1 (Strike result Crushing). Crushing at 0 dB (~+3 dB over Hit as played); same family as hit, not a boom. Fixed pitch, ±4% jitter/±1 dB; no pitch_scale for speed. See CUE_NOTES_BATTLE_V1.md.

sfx_battle_crit.notes: Haex go 2026-10-10 via the Director. Battle v1 (Fate crit: layer on the impact, same frame). Layered on the impact on the same frame at -4 dB; at 2x/4x skip or -6 dB. Fixed pitch, ±4% jitter/±1 dB; no pitch_scale for speed. See CUE_NOTES_BATTLE_V1.md.
